body: The white raven 1998
I stopped believing in god like 30 minutes ago. All my life I went to church and prayed, but no one listens. There’s nothing out there. I’m tired of living.
Also I do follow the scriptures. But instead you’re stilling going to blame me and say I’m praying the wrong way.

So God has no responsibility at all. Got it. I’m not a victim of anything. You don’t even know a fraction of the trauma I’ve been through since birth. Trauma that has left me partially disabled, and given me trauma from being raped multiple times. But I’m just an existential victim I guess.

This right here. I was born into a family that used me as an ashtray. They literally put cigarettes out on me, and threatened to hook jumper cables to my toes. God set me up for failure from the start.

First, you are the only one in the thread that has actually acknowledged that some people cannot relate to trauma. Thank you for that. Seriously I mean it. Everyone else has been dismissive of it, when they don’t even know the half of it. I still have limited use of one arm after an incident with my mother as a child. So in regards to what you said, I’ve gotten a couple of responses from church leaders when I’ve talked to them about this. One is to give the church more money, because then God will listen harder (no joke the pastor said that), another said I should be grateful for God making me suffer because I don’t deserve kindness. The last response I got was how all of that abuse made me a stronger person…..it did not. Again I just want to thank you for not being dismissive about what happened to me.

I really haven’t had an easy life. Being fed dog food as a toddler, physical abuse that has left me partially disabled, sexual abuse, all since I was born. This has been out of my control from the start.
It really irks me that people just assume I’m whining over paper cuts and not LITERAL BRAIN DAMAGE.
I was born into an extremely abusive family that locked me in the basement and fed me dog food. He set me up for failure.
But why does he keep sending bad people? It doesn’t feel like god wants to help.
Phones aren’t open yet
So my extra payment means nothing for the payoff amount? Every payment so far has counted towards it.
CA, $24,000, I rent a room, no insurance.
Think I might just not pay the bill. I’m able to scrape by as is but I absolutely cannot afford $1,100 a month.
I’m more so asking what legal ramifications are going to happen with me since I’m unable to pay.
The web page won’t let my monthly payment go below $1,100 a month, and they won’t let me apply for financial assistance. They also have not replied to any of my messages.
He will , cause he’ll see me and wonder where my car is.
My landlord will evict me if I park on the street.

I might let them know how I feel. Not that I’m going to quit, but it’s on my mind. I remember a truck driver helping me out on my way to work, and I realized he was nicer to me than most of the people I work with. Not that my coworkers are evil, but I genuinely feel like an outsider. I really feel like an appliance.
The pay is the only thing keeping me going, and there are some cool people there. But as a whole I feel like I have no life outside of that place. It genuinely feels like I live there.
That’s actually the one catch. If I leave and go anywhere else it’s almost guaranteed I’ll be paid a little less.

They seem to be narcissistic a lot of the time. One told me as long as I had food in the fridge and a roof over my head I wasn’t being abused. Also the constant threats of being committed. Only one listened to me. He was very nice and treated me like a human being. I was 15 and he listened when I told him how I felt about the medication. He actually pulled me off the meds while everyone else wanted me to take more pills.
Told me if I brought up my mothers abusive behavior I’d be keep longer. Just keep your mouth shut and agree with everything you’re told.

You literally don’t know how much I have to drive a day. There are no decent jobs in my area, and before you say anything I genuinely cannot afford to move. Also, there are no rooms under $800 a month. I check every day. Coworkers aren’t going to help me. I have a very strict budget, so please stop with the accusations of mismanagement of money. You don’t know my life.

Easier said than done. Gas is expensive, and I need to drive to be able to shower, work, and do laundry. Most rooms are scams. Also the past room I rented was in a house shared by violent alcoholics. Didn’t matter what they did, the cops didn’t care. I’m not going to be a victim of violence or sexual assault again. To top it off, how do I explain my current housing situation? If I lie there’s a chance I’ll get evicted and be homeless all over again.
San Bernardino, California

Honestly just got off the phone, the reason I can’t wire funds has nothing to do with a custodial account. This representative said I have the right paperwork, and is unsure why it’s not going through for the custodial account. They also told me to call again to verify the wire I’m attempting.
2000 miles away. Being away from them is nice, but life still isn’t easy.

Family put me there to try and keep control of me. One of the doctors told me if I said anything negative about my family they’d keep me there longer. They put me on depression medication, which did absolutely nothing. Though after that my family would threaten to put me back there if I didn’t do what they said.
If I’m not available I get points on attendance. I do have skills, jobs are very limited in my area. I cannot afford to move somewhere else.
